run_discrete_navigation_test: run the stretch robot discrete navigation test with click CLI and --reset-nav flag
test_apply_action: test applying DiscreteNavigationAction TURN_RIGHT, TURN_LEFT, or MOVE_FORWARD to the stretch robot environment
test_navigate_to: test navigating the stretch robot to specific x, y, z coordinates using robot.nav.navigate_to
test_env_reset: test resetting the stretch pick and place environment with table, cup, and chair objects
test_load_config: test loading the stretch robot environment config with load_config and visualize set to False
